integrity: The claim is proved analytically from the published Haar-moment and second-moment spectrum identities after changing the coherent branch amplitude. Finite code checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The optimized weight minimizes average complex variance for a specified target distribution; it does not improve the universal worst-case optimum.
Using the optimized weight requires estimating or bounding the ensemble statistic \(\bar S\); calibration cost is not analyzed.
The analysis assumes the ideal Haar orbital-rotation and inverse-channel setting of the source and does not include hardware noise or relative-error guarantees near overlap zeros.
title: Optimal branch weighting for complex fermionic overlap shadows
